title: Runner bundle transfers use 44,000-character mailbox parts; about 240 KiB parts would cut message count
outcome: An author candidate reaches a native runner and its run can start within about a minute of sending, with integrity checked, and without widening who may push test refs.
acceptance: Where the time goes in one real transfer today is measured: bundle size, part count and size, turns on each side, refusals and waits.
With the chosen fix, a real candidate of typical size reaches a native runner and its run starts within about a minute of sending, with the bundle's hash checked on arrival.
No new authority: test refs stay the integration owner's and the Merger's, merge-ready only. Any TermAl change has a review pair with no Medium or higher and the normal gate.
